name: The Finals: TSM TGM25
summary:
Step into the Arena with the official TSM loadout and show your support where it matters most. This bundle is packed with exclusive cosmetics to rep your team in every match—while fueling their climb in the esports scene.

This bundle includes:

- 1 Legendary Outfit with Legendary Effect,
- 1 Epic Jersey,
- 1 Epic Emote,
- 1 Epic Player Card,
- 1 Epic Charm,
- 1 Rare Spray,
- 1 Epic Sticker,
- 1 Epic Jump Pad Skin,
- 1 Epic RPG-7 Skin,
- 1 Epic Weapon Skin (93R).
